# Guillaume Bogard

> > A functional programming expert's portfolio showcasing expertise in Scala, stream processing, and infrastructure automation.

Guillaume Bogard is a software engineer specializing in functional programming with Scala, distributed systems, and DevOps infrastructure. The site features technical tutorials, blog posts, and video crash courses on modern software engineering practices.

## Key Topics

- Scala
- Functional Programming
- Cats Library
- Type Classes
- Stream Processing (fs2)
- JSON Handling (Circe)
- Kafka
- NixOS
- Terraform
- Error Handling
- Monad Transformers
- Distributed Systems
- React
- Redux Saga
- DevOps

## Core

- [λ Guillaume Bogard](https://guillaumebogard.dev): Homepage showcasing Guillaume Bogard's functional programming expertise
- [Resume](https://guillaumebogard.dev/resume): Resume detailing Guillaume's experience in Scala, Rust, and functional programming

## Functional Programming Guides

- [Functional error handling with monads, monad transformers and Cats MTL](https://guillaumebogard.dev/posts/functional-error-handling): Guide to functional error handling using Scala, Cats, and monad transformers
- [Understanding Type classes in Scala : extending types you don't own](https://guillaumebogard.dev/posts/typeclasses): Comprehensive guide to type classes in Scala and their evolution in Dotty

## Scala & Stream Processing Tutorials

- [Working with JSON in Scala, a Circe Crash Course](https://guillaumebogard.dev/videos/json-handling-scala-circe): Video crash course on Circe JSON library for Scala with encoders and decoders
- [Functional stream processing with Scala, a crash course on fs2](https://guillaumebogard.dev/videos/fs2-crash-course): Introductory video tutorial on fs2 stream processing library for Scala

## Infrastructure & Systems Design

- [Taming Cloud Infrastructure with NixOS, Terraform, and Colmena](https://guillaumebogard.dev/posts/declarative-server-management-with-nix): Tutorial on reproducible server management using NixOS, Terraform, and Colmena
- [Moving away from a legacy system using Scala and Kafka - Part 1](https://guillaumebogard.dev/posts/moving-away-from-a-legacy-system-using-scala-and-kafka/part-one-building-blocks): Case study on migrating legacy systems using Scala and Kafka at Canal+

## Content Collections

- [Posts](https://guillaumebogard.dev/posts): Blog posts on Scala, NixOS, functional programming, and DevOps infrastructure
- [Videos](https://guillaumebogard.dev/videos): Video tutorials on Scala, Circe, fs2, and functional programming crash courses
